scope: Qwen3-VL request-path host-to-device and device-to-host staging
finding: No request-path DeviceBuffer::from_host synchronize found. Load-time immutable decoder rope tables still use from_host and are explicitly out of the request path.

weights_load_once.mechanism: pinned WeightUploader slot + memcpy_htod_async + per-slot Event retention; loaded once in Qwen3VlExecutor::new

image_pixels_and_host_rows.mechanism: plan_pinned_staging assigns disjoint per-image pixel/frame ranges; VisionWork pre-stages all images into immutable pinned regions before the first async H2D; copy_prefix enqueues memcpy_htod_async from those disjoint slices

rope_and_frame_offsets.mechanism: disjoint pinned frame regions pre-staged once; foreground rows/rope pinned tables filled once; retained until fence

output.mechanism: download_output_into -> memcpy_dtoh_async into request pinned HostIo output

completion.mechanism: event record after launches; wait only in deferred completion/drop; no success-path Stream::synchronize in launch

decoder_metadata.mechanism: request-specific HostIoLease pinned input; pack_decoder_metadata then upload

decoder_rope_tables.mechanism: DeviceBuffer::from_host during DecoderModel::new; immutable weight/table setup, not a per-request upload

submit_use.mechanism: Qwen3VlEngine::submit uses blocking acquire; direct same-thread held-two callers must release one owner first

acquire.mechanism: normal blocking SlotPool::acquire per Root policy; BackendThread completion thread releases slots

one_context_bind.mechanism: one bind per submission; forward_outputs_with has no bind; sync public forward wrapper binds separately

non_claims: Source-only audit; no GPU/request execution. Load-time from_host is not converted here.
No try_acquire or public try_submit is adopted.

multi_image_disjoint.source_immutability: No pinned source region is rewritten after the first H2D enqueue.
multi_image_disjoint.arena: host_pixels/host_frames capacities are key.staged_pixels/key.staged_frames; bytes charged at totals; device pixels/frame_offsets remain max-sized.

media_validation.image: config-aware patch_dim/merge_size preflight in prepare_batch before empty selector on both async and sync routes
media_validation.audio: non-empty audios typed-rejected before empty selector and GPU
media_validation.selectors: bounds, duplicates and mixed pooled/raw rejected before lease
